name: RetroArch (mGBA)
location: RetroArch save folder (savefile_directory, sorted by core or content when enabled)
notes: The mGBA core exposes the save chip as RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM at its exact size (retro_get_memory_size, src/platform/libretro/libretro.c), without the clock; 128 KiB of 0xFF until the game has saved once.
